top: IShowSpeed was on a Zoom call about a documentary when Barack Obama suddenly joined. Speed greeted him in Indonesian… and Obama answered in Indonesian.
comment: Obama spent part of his childhood in Jakarta. He even told Speed he had the right accent.
topic_it: IShowSpeed in videochiamata (16 nov) per il documentario 'The Eyes of Ghana'; arriva Obama (produttore esecutivo), Speed lo saluta in indonesiano e Obama risponde in indonesiano

title: Obama actually spoke INDONESIAN to Speed?! 🤯 #ishowspeed #obama #viral
description:
IShowSpeed greeted Barack Obama in Indonesian on a surprise Zoom call, and Obama, who spent part of his childhood in Jakarta, answered in Indonesian.
